hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The Malagasy, Tandroy-Mahafaly [tdx] in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 subsumes varieties of which some pairs are lexically too distant to presume intelligibility (**hh:hv:Verinetal:Malagasy**, **hh:hvw:ServaPasquini:Madagascar:2020**, **hh:hv:Servaetal:Malagasy**). A possible improvement is to separate a Mahafaly-Antanalana entry from (at least some) Tandroy varieties. See also: Tandroy Malagasy [tdx].
